scope: Proposition 5.3 of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4aa0d0c5f7298f8e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 24-25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose the program of Proposition 5.1 is infinite. After discarding finitely many stages, there are proper bimeromorphic morphisms µi : Yi −→ Xi with Yi strongly Q-factorial and compact Kähler, and effective real boundaries Θi, with the following properties. MINIMAL MODEL PROGRAMS ON KÄHLER FOURFOLDS 25 (i) The natural maps between the Yi are isomorphisms in codimension one, and Qi,Yi := KYi + Θi + λiHYi = µ∗ i Li(λi) (5.2) is nef. Each ordinary pair (Yi, Θi) is klt and terminal. (ii) On a fixed first model Y = Yi0 , write Θi,Y for the strict transform of Θi. These boundaries have a fixed finite containing support and decrease coefficientwise to an effective real boundary ΘY . The ordinary pair (Y, ΘY ) is klt and terminal. (iii) The strict transform of ΘY on each Yi pushes forward to ∆i under µi. Here terminal means that every exceptional prime has log discrepancy strictly greater than one.
